build.beforeDevCommand: bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd); cd "$ROOT"; mkdir -p runtime/dev/logs; LOG=runtime/dev/logs/vite.log; PIDFILE=runtime/dev/logs/vite.pid; : > "$LOG"; echo "[tauri.dev] $(date -Is) beforeDevCommand: ensure vite on :5173" >> "$LOG"; HAS_CURL=0; if command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then HAS_CURL=1; fi; if [ "$HAS_CURL" = "1" ] && curl -fsS --max-time 1 http://127.0.0.1:5173 >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "[tauri.dev] Vite déjà actif sur :5173 — skip beforeDevCommand" | tee -a "$LOG"; exit 0; fi; export PATH="$ROOT/.tools/node/current/bin:$PATH"; NODE_MAJOR=$(node -p "Number(process.versions.node.split(\".\")[0])" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); if [ "${NODE_MAJOR:-0}" -ge 23 ]; then NODE_OPTIONS="${NODE_OPTIONS:-}"; NODE_OPTIONS="${NODE_OPTIONS//--experimental-strip-types/}"; case " $NODE_OPTIONS " in *" --no-experimental-strip-types "*) ;; *) NODE_OPTIONS="$NODE_OPTIONS --no-experimental-strip-types" ;; esac; export NODE_OPTIONS="$(echo "$NODE_OPTIONS" | xargs)"; fi; PNPM="$ROOT/.tools/node/current/bin/pnpm"; if [ ! -x "$PNPM" ]; then PNPM=$(command -v pnpm || true); fi; if [ -z "${PNPM:-}" ]; then echo "[tauri.dev] ERROR: pnpm introuvable" | tee -a "$LOG"; exit 1; fi; rm -f "$PIDFILE"; nohup "$PNPM" exec vite dev --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5173 --strictPort >> "$LOG" 2>&1 & VPID=$!; echo "$VPID" > "$PIDFILE"; echo "[tauri.dev] Vite lancé (pid=$VPID)" | tee -a "$LOG"; if [ "$HAS_CURL" != "1" ]; then echo "[tauri.dev] curl introuvable — skip wait-for-ready" | tee -a "$LOG"; exit 0; fi; for i in $(seq 1 80); do if curl -fsS --max-time 1 http://127.0.0.1:5173 >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "[tauri.dev] Vite ready on :5173" | tee -a "$LOG"; exit 0; fi; if ! kill -0 "$VPID" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "[tauri.dev] ERROR: Vite a arrete trop tot (pid=$VPID)" | tee -a "$LOG"; exit 1; fi; sleep 0.25; done; echo "[tauri.dev] ERROR: Vite non joignable après timeout — kill pid=$VPID" | tee -a "$LOG"; kill "$VPID" 2>/dev/null || true; exit 1'
